$comment: SSOT — single source of truth for pipeline version, engine, colour model and release gates (svg_cad T0). Resolves version drift (E-4) and colour-model ambiguity (E-5). State docs MUST reference this file instead of duplicating values. Code reads gates from here via ops/scripts/pipeline_config.py.

source_dataset.owner_decision: 2026-11-19 addendum v1.1; intake from these folders only

spec_lineage: TZ v3.0 (HiFi deterministic) -> v3.1 (monochrome+sketch) -> v3.2 (portrait detail) -> CR v3.3 (rebuild+naming) -> CR v3.4 (photo intake/de-chrome) -> CR v3.5 (mode-recovery fallback)

starvector.reason: Hallucinates trained logos/fonts; replaced by deterministic VTracer pipeline since TZ v3.0. The '8B INT4 vs 1B' question is moot — neither is on the active path.

monochrome.note: Canonical for final SVG output (owner decision 2026-06-19). Supersedes the Zero Black Policy for the release artifact since TZ v3.1; enforced by compile_svg.validate_monochrome.

legacy_multitoken.note: design-tokens.json (locked) + Zero Black Policy apply ONLY to the legacy colour path, not to the active monochrome output.

SKETCH_VECTOR.rationale: SSIM scores trace fidelity to the XDoG line mask, not recognizability; 0.75 is intentional (261ca96 / CR v3.5). Do not roll back.

STANDARD_VECTOR.rationale: hifi_vectorize.SSIM_RELEASE_GATE — segmentation fidelity of the monochrome fill.

topology.note: Minimal eligibility FLAG only (svg_cad T2). Full manifold/geometry validation is deferred to the compile_3mf.py TZ — do not implement here.

physical_scale.note: Reserved for R-06. The canonical viewBox is in px; physical mapping is declared per-artifact in metadata (value computed by a later stage, not here).

three_mf.$comment: Stage 4 (compile_3mf.py). px_to_mm = target_long_side_mm / max(viewBoxW, viewBoxH), per artifact. Override hierarchy: CLI > COMP-*.json 'three_mf_override' > this block.

owner_decisions.2026-06-19_color_model: Monochrome #000000 is canonical/active; Zero Black Policy scoped to the legacy --color pipeline.
owner_decisions.2026-06-19_branch_base: svg_cad branched from master (commit 7809d58), which already contains 261ca96 and feat/classifier-tonal-routing work.
